title: Multistage condensation phase change mixing white eliminating equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses multi-stage condensation phase-change mixing white eliminating equipment which comprises a shell, wherein one side of the shell is fixedly and communicated with a smoke inlet pipe, the other side of the shell is fixedly and communicated with an air inlet pipe, a fan is arranged in the air inlet pipe, the bottom and the top of the shell are respectively fixedly and communicated with a drain pipe and a chimney, two groups of heat exchange components are arranged in the shell, each group of heat exchange components comprises a plurality of heat exchange plates which are arranged in parallel, a plurality of rectangular plates are also fixed in the shell, every two rectangular plates of the rectangular plates are correspondingly arranged, and an adjusting part for adjusting the angle of the heat exchange plates is arranged in the two corresponding rectangular plates. When the heat exchange plates need to be cleaned, the motor is started to drive the screw rod to rotate, the connecting plate, the pull rod and the sliding block are driven to move when the screw rod rotates, the heat exchange plates are driven to rotate when the sliding block moves, and the heat exchange plates are rotated to an inclined state, so that the water sprayed by the spray head is more effective in flushing impurities on the heat exchange plates.

title: Closed tower with self-cleaning structure
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of closed cooling towers and discloses a closed tower with a self-cleaning structure, which comprises a tower body, wherein a water tank is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the tower body, a funnel is connected to a water inlet of the water tank, the side edge of the funnel is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the tower body, a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inside of the water tank, a motor is fixedly connected to one side of the tower body, an output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a push rod penetrating through the tower body and the water tank, one end of the push rod is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, a cleaning brush is arranged on one side of the fixing plate, which is close to a water outlet of the funnel, of the fixing plate, and a cleaning brush is arranged on one side of the fixing plate, which is close to the water outlet of the funnel. According to the utility model, the push rod is driven by the operation of the motor so as to drive the fixed plate to perform front-back linear motion, the service life of the spraying system is prolonged, and the air is sent into the box body from the air inlet pipe, so that the air cooling efficiency is effectively prevented from being influenced in rainy and snowy days while the air is cooled.

title: Sand prevention device of cooling tower
abstract: The utility model discloses a sand prevention device of a cooling tower, which comprises a sand prevention box, wherein one side of the top end of the sand prevention box is connected with a gas pipe, the other end of the gas pipe is connected with a treatment cylinder, the top end of the treatment cylinder is connected with a top cover, one side of the sand prevention box, which is far away from the gas pipe, is connected with a gas inlet grating plate, and the inner side of the sand prevention box is provided with a clamping groove; the combined use between link, cleaning brush, connecting rod and the spring that utilizes the setting can realize the vertical reciprocating motion of cleaning brush, make things convenient for follow-up to carrying out cleaning treatment to sand control board etc. and then prevent to use for a long time the back with this, have more impurity etc. to adsorb in sand control board's surface to influence follow-up air's circulation, make the connecting rod drive the spring and take place deformation thereupon when link longitudinal movement, combine the produced reverse effort of spring deformation can assist the cleaning brush to carry out vertical reciprocating motion, and then can carry out cleaning treatment to sand control board etc. and the practicality is higher.

title: Oily wastewater treatment device for range hood
abstract: The utility model discloses a lampblack absorber oily effluent treatment plant of lampblack absorber equipment technical field, comprising a main body, the rectangular channel has been seted up to the lateral wall of main part front end, the main part is located the inside of rectangular channel and has seted up the work inner chamber, the inside one end bottom of work inner chamber is run through and has been seted up and run through the groove, the bottom of main part is provided with collection oil extraction mechanism, the oil trap has been seted up at collection oil extraction mechanism's top, collection oil extraction mechanism is located the oil trap bottom and runs through groove position assorted one end and has seted up the circular recess, the inside seal fixedly connected with flowing back coupling hose of circular recess, the one end fixedly connected with connection port of circular recess is kept away from to flowing back coupling hose, collection oil extraction mechanism top is close to the equal fixedly connected with block subassembly in both ends that main part one side kept away from each other. The device has simple structure and simple and convenient operation, effectively saves labor and time, and further avoids influencing users.

title: Dirt cleaning device for air conditioner cooling tower
abstract: The utility model discloses a dirt cleaning device for an air conditioner cooling tower, which relates to the technical field of cooling towers and comprises a water collecting disc, wherein a plurality of bases are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the water collecting disc, a fixed seat is fixedly arranged at the central position of the inner bottom of the water collecting disc, a supporting tube is fixedly arranged at the central position in the fixed seat, the upper end of the supporting tube is fixedly connected with a spraying mechanism, a water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at one side of the fixed seat, a channel between the water inlet pipe and the supporting tube is communicated, and a water outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the water collecting disc at one side of the water inlet pipe. Set up desilting mechanism in the water collecting tray, desilting mechanism comprises collar, fixed frame, installing frame and collecting bag, can drive fixed frame and installing frame through the collar conveniently and rotate in the water collecting tray to cooperate the baffle of the interior bottom of water collecting tray, can carry out the sediment of the interior bottom of water collecting tray and shovel and collect, promote the clear convenience of sediment in the water collecting tray, simultaneously, promote clean effect.

title: Automatic napkin separate-packaging equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses automatic napkin split charging equipment which comprises a workbench, a conveying unit and a split charging unit, wherein the conveying unit is positioned in the middle of the workbench, the split charging unit is positioned at the top of the workbench, the workbench comprises a first supporting beam and a second supporting beam, the split charging unit comprises a fixing piece and a lifting hydraulic rod, a clamping roller is movably inserted at the bottom of the fixing piece, a hot plate is arranged at the bottom of the fixing piece, the lifting hydraulic rod is fixed at the top of the second supporting beam, a hot strip is arranged at the inner side of the lifting hydraulic rod, and a cutter is movably inserted at the hot strip. The automatic feeding and discharging device has the advantages that the device is provided with the conveying belt, automatic feeding and discharging treatment can be carried out on napkin paper, feeding uniformity is guaranteed, labor force requirements are reduced, labor cost is reduced, the packaging unit is provided with the packaging film rolling shaft, automatic feeding of packaging materials can be achieved, and the clamping roller and the hot plate are arranged and matched to achieve automatic scalding treatment of edges of the packaging materials.

title: Intelligent moisturizing and glue collecting equipment
abstract: The intelligent moisture-preserving glue collecting equipment comprises a locking device, a moisture control device, a travel device, a moving device, an adjusting device, a step device, a cutting device, an anti-theft device and a positioning device, wherein the moisture control device forms a closed space to keep air humidity, is favorable for prolonging glue discharging time of a cutting surface, can effectively prevent dust fall, has the advantages of improving yield and all-weather operation and greatly reducing impurities and mechanical failure rate in juice, the moving device, the adjusting device, the step device and the cutting device cooperate to complete glue cutting action, has the characteristics of small friction force and high stability, the step device accurately controls a falling knife, blade movement and equipment movement accurately and step-by-step control, the equipment execution efficiency is high, the structure is simple and reliable, the anti-theft device carries out sensing early warning and reporting on risks and damages of the equipment, and can actively and timely take measures to reduce corresponding losses as much as possible when the equipment is possibly stolen and damaged through the positioning device.

title: Die cutting machine
abstract: The invention discloses a die cutting machine which comprises a frame, wherein the frame is used for providing support, a shell is arranged on the frame, a fixed plate and a limiting plate are arranged in the shell, an inlet is formed in a first end of the shell, an outlet is formed in a second end of the shell, and a discharging assembly is arranged on the first end of the shell; the embossing assembly is arranged on the shell and is close to the discharge end of the discharging assembly; the first driving component is arranged on the shell, and the output end of the first driving component is connected with the input ends of the discharging component and the embossing component; the stamping component is arranged on the discharge end of the embossing component, and the output end of the stamping component is arranged towards the second end of the shell; the second driving component is arranged on the shell, and the output end of the second driving component is connected with the stamping component; the guide assembly is arranged in the shell. The invention processes and treats through different components, and the die cutting machine can produce the cutlery boxes with different thickness and different structures, thereby meeting different requirements.

title: Automatic send and cut out felt device
abstract: The utility model provides an automatic felt feeding and cutting device, which comprises a frame, wherein an electric supporting roller and an electric compression roller which are arranged in parallel are arranged in the frame, and the electric compression roller is positioned right above the electric supporting roller; a rodless cylinder parallel to the electric support roller is mounted on the rack, a sliding block is arranged on the rodless cylinder, a first cylinder is connected to the sliding block, and the extending end of the first cylinder is downwards connected with a cutter assembly; and a bracket is arranged in the rack and below the cutter assembly. In the structure of the utility model, the flexible coiled material can be automatically sent out and cut through the matching of the electric roller, the rodless cylinder and the cutter assembly, thereby reducing the labor force and avoiding the waste of coiled materials while increasing the cutting degree and the cutting efficiency; the electric roller is divided into an electric support roller and an electric compression roller, the distance between the electric compression roller and the electric support roller is adjustable, and the electric compression roller can adapt to the sending out and cutting of flexible coiled materials with different thicknesses.

title: Melt and spout cloth wind-up roll and twine mucilage binding and put
abstract: The utility model discloses a melt and spout cloth wind-up roll rubber wrapping device relates to melt and spout cloth rolling equipment technical field, including the frame of rolling up, the shaping has the silo of putting on the frame of rolling up, place the wind-up roll on the silo, the fiber container has been cup jointed on the wind-up roll, it has the sliding seat to slide around the frame of rolling up, be equipped with the actuating mechanism that the drive sliding seat removed on the frame of rolling up, it has the upset arm to articulate on the sliding seat, it stretches out end and upset arm articulated hydro-cylinder to articulate on the sliding seat, upset arm upper portion is equipped with the blowing roller, upset arm lower extreme commentaries on classics is equipped with the drive roller, be fixed with the second motor on the upset arm, the slope is equipped with on the upset arm and smooths the board, it is fixed with the support frame on the board to smooths, be fixed with the cylinder on the support frame, the cylinder stretches out the end and is fixed with the vaulting pole, vaulting pole end portion is fixed with the negative pressure suction cup, elasticity is equipped with the cutter on the support frame, be equipped with the board that dials that is used for stirring the cutter on the vaulting pole. The utility model provides a use convenient reliable, can effectively improve to twine a melt and spout cloth wind-up roll and twine mucilage binding and put of gluing efficiency.

title: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title: Protective housing of electronic equipment and electronic equipment
abstract: The application provides a protective shell of electronic equipment and the electronic equipment, wherein the protective shell of the electronic equipment comprises a main body; the bracket is arranged on the main body; the first magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the first side of the bracket, and the second magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the second side of the bracket.

title: Intelligent electrical equipment, single chip microcomputer adaptive to microwave detector and microwave detector
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent electric device, a single chip microcomputer adapted to a microwave detector, a microwave detector and a microwave transmitting method thereof, wherein the microwave detector is adapted to a single chip microcomputer, wherein the single chip microcomputer comprises a frequency source, a single chip microcomputer main body communicably connected to the frequency source and a frequency output port, wherein the microwave detector comprises a frequency synthesizer and a transmitting circuit, wherein the frequency synthesizer can synthesize and control a transmitting frequency signal according to a basic frequency provided by the frequency source of the single chip microcomputer after communicably connected to the frequency output port, wherein the transmitting circuit is communicably connected to the frequency synthesizer, wherein the transmitting circuit transmits a detecting microwave according to the transmitting frequency signal synthesized and controlled by the frequency synthesizer, the microwave detector does not use a crystal oscillator, and is beneficial to miniaturization and integration of the microwave detector.

title: Optical isolation type rotary-changing processing circuit
abstract: The invention discloses an optical isolation type rotary transformer processing circuit which comprises an MCU, an optical isolation module, a rotary transformer resolving module, a following amplifying module, a push-pull filtering module, a rotary transformer and a power module, wherein the MCU controls the signal output of the rotary transformer resolving module through the optical isolation module, the output of the rotary transformer resolving module is electrically connected with the following amplifying module, the following amplifying module is electrically connected with the push-pull filtering module, the push-pull filtering module is electrically connected with the rotary transformer, the feedback signal of the rotary transformer is electrically connected with the rotary transformer resolving module, resolving data are transmitted to the MCU through the optical isolation module, and the MCU, the optical isolation module, the rotary transformer resolving module, the following amplifying module and the push-pull filtering module are all electrically connected with the power module.

title: Solid-state relay
abstract: The utility model relates to a solid-state relay which comprises a base, a bottom plate and a silicon controlled rectifier, wherein the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the base, the silicon controlled rectifier is arranged on the bottom plate, a plurality of rivets are arranged below the base, riveting holes are formed in the bottom plate corresponding to the rivets, and the rivets of the base penetrate through the riveting holes to realize riveting with the bottom plate.

title: Resin composition molded body
abstract: This resin composition molded body contains 50% by mass or more of an olefin-based polymer A, and satisfies the following requirements (i) and (ii). (i) The amount of oxygen atoms on the surface of the resin composition molded body as determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 0.01 atom% to 8.5 atom% inclusive. (ii) The surface wetting tension of the resin composition molded body is 25 mN/m to 45 mN/m inclusive.

title: Super absorbent polymer and method for preparing same
abstract: The present invention relates to a super absorbent polymer and a method for preparing the same. According to the method for preparing a super absorbent polymer of the present invention, the super absorbent polymer +having improved absorption capacity and permeability can be prepared.

title: Curable resin composition, cured body, cellulose nanofiber material, and method for producing cellulose nanofiber material
abstract: To provide a curable resin composition in which a cellulose nanofiber material is highly and evenly dispersed, a cured body, and a cellulose nanofiber material for a filler and a method for producing the same.SOLUTION: A curable resin composition contains a cellulose nanofiber material, a monomer and a crosslinking agent. The cellulose nanofiber material contains a cellulose nanofiber material of skin of grape. When the cellulose nanofiber is 100 pts.mass, the cellulose nanofiber material contains 5 pts.mass or more and 50 pts.mass or less of an organic solvent soluble matter extracted by a mixed solvent of ethanol and toluene (volume ratio of 1:2) from the cellulose nanofiber material by boiling refluxing with a Soxhlet extractor for 6 hours.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Cellulose fiber, fiber reinforced resin composition, method for producing cellulose fiber, and method for producing fiber reinforced resin composition
abstract: Provided are a cellulose fiber containing cellulose II, the cellulose fiber having improved heat resistance, as well as a fiber reinforced resin composition, a method for producing the cellulose fiber, and a method for producing the fiber reinforced resin composition. The cellulose fiber contains the cellulose II having a content of an imidazolium salt of 1% by mass or less.

title: Copper particulate dispersion
abstract: The present invention relates to a copper microparticle dispersion containing copper nanoparticles A having an average particle diameter of 50 to nm and 350 to nm, modified cellulose B having a content of 2500 mass ppm or less, which is an anionically modified cellulose fiber having a modification group of 1 or more selected from the group consisting of (a) a hydrocarbon group and (B) a polymer group, and a dispersion medium C, and a method for producing a joined body using the copper microparticle dispersion.

title: Display device
abstract: The present invention relates to a display device. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a display device includes a cover window, a display panel disposed under the cover window and including a display area provided with a plurality of sub-pixels and an optical area disposed between the plurality of sub-pixels in the display area and having a through hole disposed therein, an adhesive layer disposed under the display panel and including a first adhesive unit disposed to surround the through hole and having conductivity and a second adhesive unit surrounding the first adhesive unit, and a metal plate disposed under the adhesive layer.

title: Display device and manufacturing method of display device
abstract: Provided are a display device and a manufacturing method of the display device. A method for manufacturing a display device comprises the steps of: applying a first resin to one surface of a mother substrate and curing the same to form a frame including an opening; applying a second resin to the opening of the frame and curing the same to form a protective member; and cutting the mother substrate along a gap between the protective members after removing the frame, wherein the second resin includes a material different from the first resin.

title: Display device
abstract: An embodiment of the present application provides a display device including a substrate, a driving circuit layer, a light emitting device layer, and a color filter unit that are disposed in a stacked manner; at least one of the light emitting device layer or the color filter unit is provided with a buffer groove in which a plurality of elastic particles are provided. When the display device is subject to an impact, a plurality of elastic particles in the buffer groove are compressed and deformed after being pressed, so as to play a role of buffering and effectively improve the impact resistance of the display device.

title: Display device
abstract: To improve the performance of a display device.SOLUTION: A display device DSP1 includes: a terminal TM1 electrically connected to a first electrode of an LED element (inorganic light-emitting diode element) 20; and a terminal TM2 electrically connected to an electrode 20E2 of the LED element 20. In a plan view, the terminal TM1 is disposed at a position overlapping with the LED element 20, and the terminal TM2 is disposed so as to continuously surround the periphery of the LED element 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: Electrooptical device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To provide an electrooptical device excellent in specifying a view angle and an electronic apparatus.SOLUTION: An electrooptical device comprises: a first light emitter for emitting light of a first wavelength region from a first light-emitting region; a second light emitter for emitting light of a second wavelength region from a second light-emitting region; a third light emitter for emitting light of a third wavelength region from a third light-emitting region; a first filter that transmits the light of the first wavelength region and the light of the second wavelength region and that blocks the light of the third wavelength region; and a second filter that transmits the light of the first wavelength region and the light of the third wavelength region and that blocks the light of the second wavelength region. The third wavelength region is shorter than the second wavelength region. The second wavelength region is shorter than the first wavelength region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title: Material centering device
abstract: The utility model discloses a well device is decided to material, include: the two mounting seats are oppositely arranged at intervals along the width direction of the material; and the centering mechanism comprises two retaining roller assemblies which are respectively arranged on the two mounting bases, and each retaining roller assembly comprises a retaining roller mounting part connected with the mounting base and a plurality of retaining rollers which are rotatably arranged on the retaining roller mounting part, and in the conveying process of the material, the two sides of the material are respectively matched with the plurality of retaining rollers in a rolling manner. The utility model provides a material is put well, can avoid the material to become wrinkled, tensile problem, improves well-defined precision.

title: Precise cladding device for outer wall of cylinder piston rod
abstract: The utility model discloses a precise cladding device for the outer wall of an oil cylinder piston rod, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein the inner end of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a first support frame, the interior of the first support frame is in rolling connection with a roller, the outer end of the first support frame is provided with a material pipe, the material pipe penetrates through the first support frame and moves along one end of the roller, the outer end of the material pipe is fixedly connected with a moving block, the interior of the first support frame is provided with a moving block guide rail, the moving block moves along the moving block guide rail, a sliding groove is arranged in a machine body, a screw rod and the moving frame are used for positioning and fixing the oil cylinder piston rod, precise cladding can be performed on the outer wall of the oil cylinder piston rod with different lengths, meanwhile, the other end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a fixed cone rod, and the rocking rocker is used for pushing the fixed plug rod to axially move towards the oil cylinder piston rod so as to clamp the oil cylinder piston rod, and stability of the oil cylinder piston rod is ensured.

title: Pipe die efficient milling device with recovery structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a pipe die efficient milling device with a recovery structure, which comprises a machine body, a base and a filter plate, wherein a water pipe is arranged in the machine body, one end of the water pipe is connected with a spray head, the base is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, the base is internally divided into a filtering bin and a water bin by the filter plate, an electric push rod is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, a push plate is arranged at one end of the electric push rod, a transmission port is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, the transmission port is communicated with a sorting bin, and a hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the top side of the inside of the sorting bin.

title: Full-automatic blanking processing equipment of blast gate blade axle
abstract: The utility model provides full-automatic blanking processing equipment of an air valve blade shaft, which comprises an installation platform, a feeding device, a blanking device, a clamping device and a chamfering device, wherein the installation platform is provided with a feeding hole; the feeding device comprises a feeding frame, a conveying belt and a pressing mechanism; the blanking device comprises a cutting mechanism and a guide rail assembly; the clamping device comprises a fixed clamping table, a translation clamping table and a driving mechanism; the chamfering device comprises a fixed chamfering mechanism fixed on one side of the fixed clamping table and a translation chamfering mechanism arranged on the other side of the fixed clamping table in a sliding manner; the guide rail assembly comprises a movable guide rail and a fixed guide rail, the fixed guide rail is arranged close to the output end of the conveying belt relative to the movable guide rail, and the movable guide rail and the fixed guide rail are parallel and obliquely arranged; the translation clamping table comprises a bearing part, a horizontal connecting part and a vertical part, the lower end of the fixed guide rail and the lower end of the movable guide rail are respectively provided with one translation clamping table, the fixed clamping table comprises a mounting seat and an abutting block, and a gap for the bearing part and the horizontal connecting part to pass through is formed between the lower surface of the abutting block and the upper surface of the mounting seat.

title: Integral hoisting structure for anchor rod group of vibrating table actuator
abstract: The utility model discloses a shaking table actuator stock group integral hoisting structure, include: installing a frame; the actuator anchor group is arranged in the mounting frame and comprises a plurality of anchor plates arranged at the bottom of the mounting frame side by side and a plurality of anchor rods, the bottoms of the anchor plates are arranged on the anchor plates, the tops of the anchor rods extend out of the mounting frame, sleeves are sleeved on the anchor rods respectively, the bottom ends of the sleeves are connected with the anchor plates, and positioning pieces are arranged between the top ends of the sleeves and the anchor rods; the hoisting piece is arranged on the mounting frame; and the locking frame is used for locking the sleeve and is arranged at the top end of the mounting frame. The utility model provides high hoisting efficiency has also guaranteed relative distance and position between a plurality of anchor slabs and the stock simultaneously, improves the accuracy control between a plurality of actuator stocks.

title: Khl polypeptide, and use thereof in preparation of tabp-eic cell
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure are a KHL polypeptide, and the use thereof in the preparation of a TABP-EIC cell. In addition, also provided in the present disclosure are a KHL polypeptide conjugate, a tumor-antigen-binding polypeptide containing the KHL polypeptide, a DNA molecule, a carrier, a host cell and a pharmaceutical composition. The tumor-antigen-binding polypeptide is composed of the KHL polypeptide, a transmembrane domain and/or a signal transduction domain.

title: Protein specifically binding to pd-1 and pharmaceutical use thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a protein specifically binding to PD-1 and a pharmaceutical use thereof. Specifically, the present disclosure provides a protein specifically binding to PD-1, a protein specifically binding to PD-1/PVRIG/TIGIT, and a use thereof in the treatment of a disease (such as cancer).

title: Mic-1 compounds and uses thereof
abstract: The invention relates to MIC-1 compounds. More specifically it relates to compounds comprising a MIC-1 polypeptide with an N-terminal amino acid extension and a protractor wherein the amino acid extension comprises 3 to 36 amino acid residues and where the MIC-1 polypeptide and the N-terminal amino acid extension together have a calculated pI lower than 6.5. The compounds of the invention have MIC-1 activity. The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds and pharmaceutically acceptable excipients, as well as the medical use of the compounds.

title: Slow-release cytokine conjugates
abstract: This disclosure generally relates to releasable cytokine conjugates and methods of using the same.

title: Molecules and compositions for inhibiting expression of complement factor b
abstract: Disclosed herein is a double stranded RNA (dsRM A) molecule for RNA interference. A method for inhibiting the expression of complement factor B (CFB) and a method for treating a complement-related disease are also provided.

title: Multifunctional cell washing preparation tube
abstract: The utility model discloses a multifunctional cell washing preparation tube which comprises a tube main body, wherein a liquid injection port is formed in the circumferential outer wall of the tube main body, a first sealing plug is fixedly arranged in the liquid injection port, a first connecting tube and a second connecting tube are respectively and fixedly connected to the two ends of the tube main body, and a first filter membrane and a second filter membrane are both arranged in the tube main body. The cell washing preparation provided by the utility model has dual purposes, remarkably simplifies the processes of cell washing and cell suspension preparation, is less influenced by environmental cleanliness, and reduces the risk of cell pollution to a certain extent.

title: Preparation and application of anti-oxidation brain-strengthening liver-protecting cyperus esculentus fat emulsion
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation and application of an antioxidant brain-strengthening liver-protecting cyperus esculentus fat emulsion, the preparation adopts the synergistic effect of the active ingredients such as the novel food raw material, namely the chufa oil, and the nervonic acid, DHA to prepare the chufa fat emulsion preparation with health care effect.

title: Medicine purification device
abstract: The utility model discloses a medicine purification device, including the purification case, purification incasement upper portion fixedly connected with keeps off the frame, it has the draw-in groove to open on the fender frame, the filter assembly has been placed on the fender frame, the filter assembly includes the filter screen, filter screen outside fixedly connected with frame, it has spacing hole to open on the frame, there is the bayonet lock to pass on the spacing hole, purification case right side is installed the motor, the motor output end is connected with the first pivot, the first pivot is connected with the steering assembly, the steering assembly is connected with the second pivot, be connected with the stirring subassembly in the second pivot, lower part fixedly connected with reverse osmosis membrane in the purification case, purification case right side lower part is connected with first discharging pipe, first discharging pipe is located the reverse osmosis membrane top, purification case right side; fix filtering component through the bayonet lock, filtering component's installation and dismantlement are all very convenient, are convenient for clear up the impurity on the filter screen, stir the liquid medicine through stirring the subassembly, can accelerate the reverse osmosis of liquid medicine, and work efficiency is high.

title: Crosslinked chitosan hemostatic powder and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the liquid absorption amount of the cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder is more than 30 times of the weight of the chitosan hemostatic powder, and the cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder is prepared by the following method: adding a chitosan raw material into an organic solvent, stirring and swelling, then dropwise adding an acid solution under a stirring state, reacting for 0.5-2 h, adding a cross-linking agent into the reaction solution for cross-linking reaction, and filtering, washing and drying after the reaction is finished to obtain the chitosan/chitosan composite material. The cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder provided by the invention has good hemostatic effect on wounds with large bleeding amount, such as severe skin surface local bleeding or arterial bleeding under emergency conditions; the preparation method provided does not need to dissolve the chitosan to prepare a solution and then carry out crosslinking reaction, well keeps the original powdery substance form of the chitosan in the preparation process, and has simple preparation process and low cost.

title: Medicine adding device
abstract: The utility model discloses a dosing device, which comprises a box body, wherein a metering pump is arranged at the top of the box body, a shell is fixedly connected with the top of the inner cavity of the box body, a stirring paddle is arranged in the inner cavity of the shell, an ultrasonic generator is arranged above the shell, one side of the stirring paddle is connected with an ultrasonic transducer through a buckle, a first conduction pipe is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the shell, a second three-way joint is arranged at the bottom end of the first conduction pipe, connecting pipes are inserted at both ends of the second three-way joint, a first stop valve is arranged at the outer side of the connecting pipes, a plastic hose is arranged at one end of the connecting pipes, a filter box is symmetrically and fixedly connected below the plastic hose, a metal filter screen is detachably connected at the inner side of the filter box, non-woven fabric filter cotton, by adjusting the first stop valve, the liquid medicine is injected into the other filter tank, so that the medicine adding device can continue to work normally.

title: Security protection structure of energy storage container
abstract: The invention discloses a security structure of an energy storage container, which comprises the following components: the lithium ion battery module is arranged on the battery rack assembly, and the energy storage box assembly at least comprises a box body; the battery rack assembly includes: a multi-layered tray for housing lithium battery modules; the brackets are arranged around the multi-layer tray in a surrounding way and used for supporting the multi-layer tray; and a plurality of radiating pipes which are arranged at the bottom of the tray and/or are arranged at the side surfaces of the two brackets at one side of the battery rack assembly, wherein: a plurality of radiating pipes arranged on the side surfaces of the two brackets on one side of the battery frame assembly are abutted on the side wall of the tank body of the energy storage tank assembly. By implementing the security structure of the energy storage container, the probability of occurrence of thermal runaway accidents of the energy storage container can be reduced, and the security application of the energy storage container is further enhanced; the structure is simple, the disassembly and the assembly are convenient, and the maintenance is convenient.

title: Distributed electrochemical energy storage system
abstract: The invention discloses a distributed electrochemical energy storage system, comprising: the system comprises a battery energy management system and a plurality of energy storage subunits, wherein each energy storage subunit comprises a battery module, a battery management unit, a charge-discharge strategy analysis module and a current conversion subunit; the battery management unit comprises a battery core data acquisition module, a module SOC/SOH calculation module and a passive equalization module; the battery energy management system is used for acquiring first data in the battery management unit and second data in the charge-discharge strategy analysis module in each energy storage subunit and making a charge-discharge strategy of the energy storage system. By implementing the invention, the battery management functions such as battery information acquisition, equalization, analysis and calculation and the like and the energy storage converter function are submerged into the battery module layer by layer, so that the energy storage system gets rid of the limitation of external organization forms; the core functions of the battery management system and the energy management system are integrated, so that the management and task issuing of the battery are more refined and more targeted.

title: Battery pack production equipment and battery pack production method
abstract: The invention discloses a battery pack production device and a battery pack production method, wherein the battery pack production device comprises: the device comprises a battery string component grabbing device, a bus bar bearing device, a welding device and a transparent bearing plate; the battery string component grabbing device is used for grabbing the battery string components; the bus bar bearing device comprises a first bus bar bearing platform, a middle bus bar bearing platform and a second bus bar bearing platform, end bus bars are respectively borne and then are moved to a welding station, and the battery string assembly grabbing device moves the battery string assembly above the bus bar bearing device, so that welding strips of the battery string assembly respectively correspond to the end bus bars on the first bus bar bearing platform, the middle bus bar bearing platform and the second bus bar bearing platform; the welding device is used for welding the welding strip of the battery string component with the end bus bar below the welding strip; the battery string grabbing device places the welded battery string assembly on the transparent bearing plate. The technical scheme provided by the invention can improve the production efficiency of the battery pack.

title: Energy storage device
abstract: The invention provides an energy storage device which comprises a box body, and a battery cell group and a heat exchange module which are arranged in the box body. The battery cell group comprises a plurality of battery cells which are adjacently arranged. The heat exchange module comprises a converging component, and at least two adjacent electric cores in the electric core group are correspondingly provided with the converging component. The converging component comprises an overlapped electric connecting sheet and a semiconductor refrigerating sheet, wherein the electric connecting sheet is used for electrically connecting two adjacent electric cores, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet is arranged on one side of the electric connecting sheet, which is away from the electric cores, and the semiconductor refrigerating sheet is used for refrigerating after the electric current in the first direction is introduced so as to dissipate heat of the electric connecting sheet. The battery cell comprises a shell, a terminal assembly, a heat conducting piece and at least two electrode assemblies which are stacked in the shell side by side, wherein the terminal assembly is electrically connected to the electric connecting sheet, the heat conducting piece is arranged between at least two adjacent electrode assemblies, and the heat conducting piece is connected to the terminal assembly to conduct heat of the electrode assemblies to the electric connecting sheet connected with the terminal assembly. The heat dissipation efficiency of the battery cell in the energy storage device is higher, and the service life of the battery cell is prolonged.

title: Lithium battery health state estimation method
abstract: The invention discloses a lithium battery health state estimation method, which comprises the steps of converting a coordinate space of a complete charging voltage data sequence and a coordinate space of a segment charging voltage data sequence into a voltage-differential voltage coordinate space, taking the complete charging voltage data sequence converted by the coordinate space as training data, taking the segment charging voltage data sequence converted by the coordinate space as verification data, training a self-adaptive sampling depth neural network based on the training data and a health state label to obtain a health state prediction model, inputting the verification data into the health state prediction model to obtain a health state prediction value sequence, sequentially extracting a plurality of sub-prediction value sequences from the health state prediction value sequence, calculating variance of each sub-prediction value sequence, and averaging health state prediction values of the sub-prediction value sequences with variances lower than a variance threshold to obtain a final lithium battery health state estimation value. The battery state of health estimation method can accurately predict the state of health of the lithium battery based on the segment voltage data sequence.

title: Preparation method of morphology-adjustable copper hydroxyphosphate multi-level micron material
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a morphology-adjustable copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material. The method comprises the following steps: uniformly stirring soluble copper salt and a buffer solution and standing to obtain a solution A; and carrying out hydrothermal synthesis reaction on the solution A, and washing and drying to obtain the copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material with different morphologies. The invention takes the buffer solution as a reaction medium, an alkali source and a phosphoric acid source, can effectively control the appearance of a product by changing the pH value of the buffer solution, has strong controllability and high practicability; the prepared copper hydroxyphosphate multilevel micron material has a special multilevel structure, excellent monodispersity and good crystallinity, and has potential application value in the field of photocatalysis; the synthesis method and the required equipment are simple, the operation is simple and convenient, the product is free from other impurity products, subsequent purification, calcination and other treatment are not needed, the method is green and environment-friendly, and the method has high practicability.

title: Hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction device for preparing nano zirconia
abstract: The utility model discloses a hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction device for preparing nano zirconia, which comprises a reaction vessel, a heating control system and a pressure control system, wherein the reaction vessel is used for carrying out hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction to prepare the nano zirconia; the heating control system is connected with the reaction container and is used for heating the reaction container so as to control the temperature of the hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction; the pressure control system comprises an air inlet pipeline and an exhaust pipeline, the air inlet pipeline is connected with the reaction container and used for introducing gas into the reaction container, so that the gas can be used for bubbling and stirring materials in the reaction container, a gas-liquid-solid three-phase reaction interface can be formed, hydrogen chloride generated by reaction can be brought out, and the exhaust pipeline is connected with the reaction container and used for exhausting the gas in the reaction container. The utility model discloses can the effective control with improve reaction condition to promote nanometer zirconia's performance, accelerate reaction rate, shorten reaction time, improve preparation efficiency.

title: Zirconium dioxide powder and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of zirconium dioxide powder, which comprises the following steps: mixing the first raw material and the second raw material, and rubbing and drying to obtain precursor powder; and calcining the precursor powder to obtain the zirconium dioxide powder. Wherein the first raw material is a high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide solution or the first raw material comprises a high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide solution and a metal salt solution; the second raw material is a solid auxiliary agent which can be decomposed under the condition of heating or friction. The high-purity zirconium organic alkoxide comprises more than one of zirconium n-butoxide, zirconium isopropoxide, zirconium n-propoxide or zirconium ethoxide. The solid auxiliary agent comprises more than one of ammonium bicarbonate, ammonium carbonate or ammonium carbamate. The zirconium dioxide powder prepared by the preparation method is also provided. The preparation method of the zirconium dioxide powder provided by the invention has the advantages of simple steps, loose preparation conditions, uniform particle size, small particles, few impurities and the like.

title: Preparation method of supermolecule self-assembled iron phosphate hexagonal tubular carbon nitride
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of supermolecular self-assembled iron phosphate hexagonal tubular carbon nitride, which comprises the following steps: mixing 1g H 3 PO 4 Dissolving in 50mL of deionized water, and then dispersing 1g of melamine into a phosphoric acid solution to prepare a suspension; different amounts of Fe (NO) 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 Dissolving O in 20mL of deionized water, transferring the solution into the suspension, stirring the suspension in a homogenizer at the speed of 10000rpm for 20min, placing the mixture in a 100mL polytetrafluoroethylene inner lining, placing the mixture in a stainless steel autoclave, reacting the mixture at 180 ℃ for 10h, cooling the reaction product to room temperature, washing and centrifuging the precipitate for 5 times by using deionized water, and drying the precipitate at 80 ℃ overnight; putting the dried precursor intoAnd (3) heating to 500 ℃ at a heating rate of 3 ℃/min in a tubular furnace under a nitrogen atmosphere, keeping for 4h, and naturally annealing to room temperature to obtain the product. The method can complete the load deposition of the iron phosphate while forming the hollow tubular carbon nitride in a supramolecular self-assembly mode, and can realize the degradation of the acetaminophen with higher efficiency and higher concentration.

title: Preparation method and application of Ag-loaded layered double hydroxide
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of double metal hydroxide, in particular to a preparation method and application of Ag-loaded layered double metal hydroxide, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving zinc nitrate hexahydrate, aluminum nitrate nonahydrate and silver nitrate in deionized water to obtain a mixed solution; s2: dripping the mixed solution obtained in the step S1 into a formamide solution, and then stirring at a low temperature in an inert gas atmosphere to obtain a reaction stock solution; s3: and (4) dropwise adding a sodium hydroxide solution into the reaction stock solution obtained in the step S2 to control the pH value and react, and centrifuging and washing the reaction product to obtain the Ag-loaded layered double hydroxide. Compared with the prior art, the synthesis method is simple, simple and convenient to operate, mild in condition, high in purity of the target product, safe and non-toxic, and capable of being synthesized in large scale at low cost.

title: Communication method, apparatus and system
abstract: A communication method, apparatus and system. The method comprises: acquiring first configuration information, and on the basis of the first configuration information, sending L sensing signals, wherein the first configuration information is used for indicating M CDM groups, each of the M CDM groups comprises a plurality of ports, the L sensing signals correspond to the plurality of ports in at least one of the M CDM groups, and L is a positive integer less than or equal to M. A plurality of ports included in at least one CDM group is configured, such that sensing signals are sent via the plurality of ports, thereby improving the communication performance and sensing performance, and improving spatial-domain gain.

title: Communication apparatus, communication method, and recording medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a communication apparatus, a communication method, and a recording medium. To provide a mechanism that enables flexible design of timing regarding communication. The communication device includes a communication control unit that controls transmission of a first channel and reception of a second channel, or vice versa, the first channel being transmitted in a first direction, the second channel being a channel corresponding to the first channel and transmitted in a second direction opposite to the first direction, and a setting unit that sets a control mode of the communication control unit to the first mode or the second mode. The communication control unit transmits and receives the first channel and the second channel in different subframes in a first mode, and transmits and receives the first channel and the second channel within the same subframe in a second mode.

title: Electronic device and method for wireless communication, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: Provided are an electronic device and method for wireless communication, and a computer-readable storage medium. The electronic device comprises: a processing circuit configured to confirm whether a first predetermined condition is met, and to determine, when it is confirmed that the first predetermined condition is met, whether to adjust a timing advance (TA) of a child node of an IAB node, wherein the determination comprises instructing the child node to execute an uplink transmission and confirming, on the basis of the timing of receiving the uplink transmission, whether to adjust the TA.

title: Communication device, control method, base station, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides communication equipment, a control method, a base station and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises a transmitting link, a receiving link, an antenna module, a coupling module, a correction frequency conversion module and a logic module, wherein the antenna module is respectively connected with the transmitting link and the receiving link, the coupling module is respectively connected with the transmitting link, the receiving link and the antenna module, the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link and/or the receiving link, when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link, the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work, the transmitting link can transmit a first correction signal of a second frequency point, the receiving link can receive the first correction signal and transmit the first correction signal to the logic module for correction of a radio frequency signal, and when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the receiving link, the transmitting link can transmit the second correction signal of the first frequency point, and the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work so that the receiving link can receive the second correction signal and transmit the second correction signal to the logic module for correction of the radio frequency signal.

title: Method, apparatus, medium, electronic device and program product for selecting antenna
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus, medium, electronic device, and program product for selecting an antenna. The method comprises the steps of determining a target antenna with optimal receiving performance from a plurality of antennas of receiving end equipment when receiving antenna performance detection signals, wherein the time interval between the ending time of receiving the antenna performance detection signals and the starting time of receiving effective transmission signals is smaller than or equal to a preset value, the preset value is larger than or equal to 0, the effective transmission signals are effective communication data between transmitting end equipment for transmitting the antenna performance detection signals and the receiving end equipment, and the effective transmission signals are received through the target antenna. Therefore, the antenna with the optimal performance can be selected in real time, so that the antenna with the optimal performance can be utilized to receive signals in time, the efficiency of selecting the antenna is improved, and the communication quality is improved.

title: Data processing method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract: A method for data processing includes the following. A terminal device determines a data duplication behavior of a first entity according to first information, where the data duplication behavior is indicative of that the first entity transmits data to at least one second entity in at least three second entities corresponding to the first entity. A terminal device and a storage medium are further provided.

title: Information processing apparatus, storage medium, and information processing method
abstract: The invention provides an information processing apparatus, a storage medium, and an information processing method, which can execute a processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request when the processing request is received from a processing request transmitting apparatus. An information processing apparatus is provided with a processor that receives a device ID and a processing request that identify the processing request transmitting device from the processing request transmitting device, and executes processing related to the processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request based on the device ID.

title: Data acquisition method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the specification discloses a data acquisition method and device and an embodiment of electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out iterative processing by using the following steps until a preset condition is met: selecting first data from a first data set according to a value prediction model, wherein the first data set comprises at least one first data, and the first data is acquired in a coarse acquisition mode; acquiring second data by using a fine acquisition mode according to the data identifier corresponding to the selected first data; acquiring characteristic data corresponding to the data identification according to the selected first data; according to the collected second data, determining a label corresponding to the data identifier; and training the value prediction model according to the label and the characteristic data. The data acquisition method, the data acquisition device and the electronic equipment in the embodiment of the specification can save the data acquisition cost.

title: Serial number writing method and device and computer readable medium
abstract: The invention provides a serial number writing method, a serial number writing device and a computer readable medium. When a write request is received, verifying the write request, and determining whether the write request is allowed to be executed, wherein the write request comprises a sequence number to be written; when the write request is allowed to be executed, analyzing the write request to acquire the sequence number to be written; judging whether the sequence number to be written is valid; and when the sequence number to be written is valid, writing the sequence number to be written into the memory of the intelligent terminal. The scheme of the invention can improve the efficiency of writing the serial number.

title: Information processing method and device and computing equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a system access request initiated by a target user aiming at a target processing system; determining decision results respectively generated by a plurality of online decision models at the target processing system in response to the system access request; determining target recommendation information based on decision results respectively corresponding to the plurality of online decision models; and outputting the target recommendation information for the target user. The embodiment of the application improves the recommendation accuracy and effectiveness.

title: Intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities
abstract: The utility model provides an intelligent vehicle is with positioner that has protective capacities, the cavity has been seted up to shells inner wall, cavity inner wall welded connection has the fixed slot, shells inner wall welded connection has strengthened the wall, shell outer wall bonding is connected with the rubber layer, through the casing, strengthen arm and rubber layer and solved the most not safeguard function of ordinary positioner among the prior art, in use easily receives the problem of damage, the problem of the complicated inconvenient installation of the most structure of ordinary positioner among the prior art has been solved through strong magnetic block, through the fixed slot, elasticity footstock and silica gel pad have solved ordinary positioner among the prior art and have mostly not protected inside, inside electronic components easily suffers vibrations and the problem of damage in the use.

title: Method and apparatus for automatic vehicle control
abstract: A method and apparatus for automatic vehicle control, the method for automatic vehicle control comprising: acquiring a first acceleration signal of a vehicle and a second acceleration signal of the vehicle; inputting the first acceleration signal into a first filter to generate a third acceleration signal, inputting the second acceleration signal into a second filter to generate a fourth acceleration signal, and enabling the phase delay characteristics of the third acceleration signal and the fourth acceleration signal to be the same; and determining the ramp angle according to the third acceleration signal and the fourth acceleration signal. The ramp angle is determined by the two paths of acceleration signals with the same phase delay characteristics, so that the problem of ramp estimation errors caused by different phase delay characteristics can be solved, and the instantaneity and the accuracy of the ramp angle estimation are improved. And the cooperative control method of the target torque is combined, so that shaking in the starting and stopping process of the vehicle is reduced, the time required for starting and stopping the vehicle is shortened, and the driving experience of a user is improved.

title: Vehicle cruise control method, system, medium, electronic equipment and vehicle machine
abstract: The application provides a vehicle cruise control method, a vehicle cruise control system, a vehicle cruise control medium, electronic equipment and a vehicle machine. The vehicle cruise control method includes: calculating according to the preset speed and the self-vehicle speed of the vehicle to obtain a speed deviation; selecting variable control parameters according to the speed deviation partition where the speed deviation is, and carrying out sectional control on the request acceleration; the speed deviation partition is a partition divided according to the speed deviation, and comprises a negative bias area, a negative bias cell, a positive bias cell and a positive bias area; and calculating and obtaining the PID control quantity of the constant-speed cruising of the vehicle according to the variable control parameter and the speed deviation. The application can improve the control precision of constant-speed cruising and reduce the speed fluctuation generated in the control process.

title: Vehicle control device
abstract: To provide a vehicle control device that can suppress a road from deteriorating.SOLUTION: A vehicle control device according to one embodiment comprises: a target route setting part that sets a target route; an offset amount determining part that determines an amount of offset with respect to the target route; a target route correcting part that generates a corrected target route offset in a lateral direction by the mount of the offset with respect to the target route; and a control part that controls a steering angle of a vehicle so that a vehicle travels along the corrected target route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Control method, control system and computer readable medium for vehicle steer-by-wire
abstract: The application relates to a control method, a control system and a computer readable medium for vehicle steer-by-wire. The control method of the vehicle steer-by-wire comprises the steps of obtaining an operating torque of a steering wheel, obtaining a value of a target torque output to a steering gear according to the operating torque and a transmission ratio, and outputting the target torque, wherein the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a first transmission ratio A1 when the corresponding vehicle speed is lower than a first speed, the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a second transmission ratio A2 when the corresponding vehicle speed is between the first speed and a second speed, the target torque is a product of the operating torque and a third transmission ratio A3 when the corresponding vehicle speed is higher than a second speed, and the relation among the first transmission ratio A1, the second transmission ratio A2 and the third transmission ratio A3 is a transmission ratio of a planetary gear mechanism, wherein A1 = 1+alpha, A2 = alpha, A3 = 1+1/alpha, and alpha is greater than 1.

title: Medical detection apparatus and measuring component thereof
abstract: A medical detection apparatus and a measuring component thereof are provided. The medical detection apparatus includes a housing and a measuring component. The measuring component is mounted on the outer wall of the housing for measuring the concentration of a parameter to be measured in the external environment of the housing. Through arrangement of the measuring component, the medical detection apparatus detects various parameters in the digestive tract, and the accuracy of detection is improved.

title: Air bubble removal cap and syringe set
abstract: An air bubble removal cap includes: a main body portion that is formed in a tubular shape and defines a hollow portion inside, the hollow portion being configured to communicate with a collection tube that accommodates a body fluid from a living body; a connection portion that is located on a proximal side of the hollow portion and to which the collection tube is connectable; an exhaust portion that is located on a distal side of the hollow portion and is configured to discharge gas discharged from the collection tube; a filter that is disposed in the hollow portion and divides the exhaust portion and the connection portion; and a scattering prevention mechanism that covers a proximal side of the filter and prevents the body fluid from scattering to the filter.

title: Method for operating a medical device and medical device operating according to the method
abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a class A medical device (10) together with a class B medical device (12), wherein the medical devices (10, 12) are joined to one another for communication, wherein the class A medical device (10) comprises a display (14) suitable for displaying texts in various languages and wherein the class B medical device (12) has no text display facility, wherein the class B medical device (12), in order to display textual or at least partially textual information (20), sends a data message (22) containing an information identifier (44) to the class A medical device (10) and wherein the class A medical device (10), on receipt of an information identifier (44), loads information (20) matching the information identifier (44) from a medical device database (26) and displays said information by means of its own display (14) for the class B medical device (12).

title: Blood coagulation measuring device, method for measuring blood coagulation time, method for determining completion of blood coagulation reaction, and blood automatic centrifugal separator
abstract: The invention discovers that: the progress of blood coagulation reaction can be observed by irradiating a blood collection tube (1) containing a blood test substance with near infrared light having a specific wavelength of 1050 nm to 1350 nm by a near infrared light source (4) and measuring the time change of the intensity of light passing through the inside of the blood test substance detected by an infrared camera (6). Thus, the completion or incompletion of the blood coagulation reaction can be determined from the tendency of increase or decrease in light intensity in addition to the measurement of the blood coagulation time, and the pretreatment step of the centrifugal separation treatment can be automated.

title: Medical device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A medical device which comprises a base material and a hydrophilic polymer layer formed on at least a part of the base material and satisfies the following conditions (a) to (d): (a) the polymer constituting the hydrophilic polymer layer is a hydrophilic polymer containing an acidic group; (b) the thickness of the hydrophilic polymer layer is more than 1nm and less than 100 nm; (c) the hydrophilic polymer layer has a ratio of the number of basic groups/acidic groups of 0.2 or less; (d) the liquid film retention time after 40 minutes after immersion in a phosphate buffer and ultrasonic cleaning is 15 seconds or more. The invention provides a medical device having a hydrophilized surface of a substrate and a method for manufacturing the medical device by a simple method.

title: Microbial fertilizer mixing arrangement
abstract: The utility model discloses a microorganism fungus fertilizer mixing arrangement belongs to agricultural microorganism fertilizer production facility technical field, including base and controller, the equal fixedly connected with fixed plate in base upper end middle part both sides, symmetry fixed plate opposite side fixedly connected with a plurality of retainer plates, equal fixedly connected with in retainer plate middle part is in mixing the storehouse surface, just mixing storehouse upper and lower extreme and being semi-circular or toper respectively, just mixing storehouse upper end middle part fixedly connected with mount, just mount upper end middle part fixedly connected with motor or air pump, the main shaft of motor runs through and sliding connection in mixing the storehouse inside through the speed reducer, main shaft upper end external surface installs a plurality of stirring rake, just main shaft lower part external surface installs helical blade, upper strata the stirring rake is radially distributed's multiunit paddle of bending, and the lower floor helical blade is continuous spiral structure, main shaft bottom external surface fixedly connected with flitch.

title: Agricultural microbial hydrogel agent with disease resistance and yield increase
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural microbial hydrogel agent with disease resistance and yield increase, which is characterized by comprising gamma-polyglutamic acid-chitosan-gelatin composite hydrogel and microbial powder, wherein the microbial powder comprises one or two of fermentation powder of bacillus subtilis MES810 and fermentation powder of bacillus licheniformis MES 816. The microbial hydrogel agent can be used for crop seedling raising, agricultural product yield increase, bacteriostasis and soil and water conservation.

title: Seed culture germinator with siphon mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a seed culture germinator with a siphon mechanism, which comprises a base and a baffle plate integrally formed with the base, wherein a housing is sleeved on the baffle plate, a plurality of placing grooves for placing culture containers are formed in the baffle plate, a siphon box with an open top is fixedly bonded on the surface of the top end of the housing, a liquid storage tank is fixedly arranged on the surface of the top end of the housing through a group of support plates, a liquid outlet mechanism for supplying liquid to the siphon box is arranged at the bottom end of the liquid storage tank, the siphon mechanism is arranged in the siphon box and consists of a fixed column and a movable column, the bottom end of the fixed column penetrates through the housing, a water collecting box is arranged under the bottom end of the fixed column, communicating pipes are welded and communicated on the side walls of the two ends of the water collecting box, and the bottom ends of the communicating pipes are welded and communicated with a liquid guide pipe. The utility model carries out nutrient solution adding operation through siphoning action, thus no manual intervention is needed, repeated operation can be continuously carried out, the use effect is good, and the popularization and the use are facilitated.

title: Indoor seedling rice breeding device
abstract: The utility model discloses an indoor seedling rice cultivating device, which comprises a cultivating cylinder, wherein a regulating plate is arranged in the middle of the front surface of the outer wall of the cultivating cylinder, a data display screen is arranged at the left part of the front surface of the outer wall of the cultivating cylinder, four corners of the bottom surface of the outer wall of the cultivating cylinder are provided with feet, a power cord plug is arranged at the bottom of the right side of the outer wall of the cultivating cylinder, a water outlet is arranged in the middle of the bottom surface of the cultivating cylinder, a drainage hose is arranged at the bottom end of the water outlet, a water inlet is arranged at the top of the left side of the outer wall of the cultivating cylinder, and a water delivery hose is arranged at the left end of the water inlet; the device is applicable to the small batch of rice seedling and cultivates, places the planting case that will cultivate the seedling in the device, and the water source is carried to the inlet tube afterwards, can realize cultivating the change of water with the drain pipe cooperation, installs a plurality of detectors additional in the device, and the feedback supplies to look over on data display screen, convenient management, and heating chamber and heating rod can be heated cultivation water, ensure that the temperature is suitable, cultivate process science, safety, facility, are worth promoting.

title: Preparation method of growth-promoting agricultural microbial agent
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a growth-promoting agricultural microbial agent, which comprises the following steps of S1, independent fermentation and propagation of strains, S2, step-by-step loading, S3, coating of a slow-release protective layer and S4 and post-treatment, wherein the optimal physiological activities of different strains are guaranteed through step-by-step independent fermentation, physical space isolation of biocontrol bacteria and growth-promoting bacteria is realized by using a pore grading carrier, the growth-promoting bacteria are loaded on the surface of porous composite carrier particles in macropores, the biocontrol bacteria are loaded in micropores in the porous composite carrier particles, the release time sequence of flora is accurately controlled by combining with a temperature-responsive slow-release wall material solution, antagonism among the strains is thoroughly avoided, the carrier microporous structure provides physical protection for the strains, the slow-release wall material automatically adjusts the disintegration rate according to the soil temperature, so that the growth-promoting bacteria preferentially colonize root systems to form a barrier, and the subsequent release of the biocontrol bacteria plays a long-acting antibacterial function.

title: Semiconductor device and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a semiconductor element, a case, a beam, and a sealing insulating material. The semiconductor element is mounted on a base plate. The case has a frame shape in plan view. The case is attached to the base plate. The case houses the semiconductor element inside the frame shape. The beam has a flat plate shape. The beam is held by the case. The beam is held over an internal space that is a space inside the frame shape of the case. The sealing insulating material fills the internal space of the case and covers at least a part of the beam. The beam is provided above the semiconductor element and covers the semiconductor element in plan view.

title: Semiconductor device and composition for forming back surface protective film
abstract: This semiconductor device comprises a semiconductor substrate, a back surface protective film that protects the back surface of the semiconductor substrate, and a forgery prevention layer that is provided on the back surface protective film and contains a pattern-forming substance that forms an authenticity-determining pattern, wherein the back surface protective film contains an inorganic pigment.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device according to an embodiment includes a metal plate, a semiconductor chip, an insulating substrate provided between the metal plate and the semiconductor chip, a frame body surrounding the insulating substrate, a mesh-shaped sheet provided between the metal plate and the frame body, an adhesive agent provided between the metal plate and the frame body, and a sealing material being surrounded by the frame body and covering the semiconductor chip and the insulating substrate.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a semiconductor device that has high electromagnetic wave shielding properties while exhibiting good heat dissipation.
